title: Meridian suffix 'AM'/'PM' incorrect after time change
description: The meridian suffix displayed in the Meridian string incorrectly flips from 'PM' to 'AM' when the time transitions from morning to evening.
steps: Observe the Meridian string at a morning time (e.g., 10:00 AM).
Wait for the time to transition to an evening time (e.g., 1:00 PM).
actual: The Meridian string displays 'AM' when the time has transitioned into the afternoon/evening (e.g., shows 1:00 AM instead of 1:00 PM).
expected: The Meridian string should correctly display 'PM' for afternoon and evening times.
